Subject: Riverfront Dev Huddle — PO request and contingency routing

Hi Kimberly,

We're moving forward with the small Riverfront Dev Huddle (target: 75 attendees, mostly local) on Aug 18. Paloma Events sent a firm quote and Anderson Catering penciled in menu pricing. High-level budget below: 

- Venue (deposit + staffing): $3,500
- Catering (lunch + coffee breaks): $2,800
- AV (basic sound + projector): $900
- Materials & signage: $400
- Travel h honoraria (2 speakers): $600
- Contingency (10% recommended): $300

Total requested (including contingency): $8,500

Ask: 1) Can we approve a PO for $8,500 (or $9,000 to preserve buffer) and 2) route cost center / GL coding? Paloma needs a PO number to lock the date — they will hold the deposit for a week.

I've attached the venue quote and a line-item workbook for finance. If you prefer the contingency to be held on the company card instead of increasing the PO, say the word and I'll update the request.

Next steps I propose: I create the PO request (with line items), Grace confirms GL/cost-center, Jonas confirms logistics and vendor W9.

Attachments: [riverfront_quote.pdf, event_line_items.xlsx]

Thanks — short on time for this one so looping you in directly.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Riverfront Dev Huddle — PO request and contingency routing

Thanks Marissa — quick questions before I green-light the PO: 

1) Can we tighten the contingency to $250 and hold it on the Redwood p-card? That keeps the committed PO at $8,500 and reduces friction for procurement.
2) Vendor W9? We need vendor tax info before Finance will issue a PO.
3) Split cost: Marketing events (85%) / Developer Outreach program (15%) — please note that in the line-items if you want split GL coding.

Assuming W9 is provided and line-items updated I can approve the PO by EOD tomorrow. Please include a note if any AV or site insurance fees are possible extras.

— Kim

Director, Demand Gen
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Kim / Marissa — finance check:

We can process as a standard vendor PO. Please note requirements to avoid delays: 

- Vendor W9 (PDF) attached to the PO request. 
- Vendor name must match legal entity on W9.
- Cost center: MKTE-EMT-2026 (use this for 85% of spend)
- Secondary cost center: DEV-OUTREACH-2026 (15% split)
- GL buckets: 6231 (events/catering), 6420 (travel/honoraria), 5999 (materials)

If Kimberly wants the contingency held on the p-card instead of the PO, indicate p-card hold in the PO notes and we'll reduce the PO amount by $250. Finance will only approve once W9 & the final itemized invoice are attached. Expected turnaround: 48 hours after complete packet submitted.

I've attached a short checklist for vendor onboarding and PO attachments.

Attachment: [finance_checklist.pdf]

— Grace

Paloma has confirmed no extra site insurance anticipated but said vendor may bill overtime if event runs past 7:30pm — I will flag that day-of.

Please issue PO number when ready and confirm GL codes above (I used the ones Grace provided). Paloma asked for PO within 48 hours to save the date.
